definitions.gloss: annual amount; yearly fee; per-year sum
definitions.explanation: A total sum of money calculated, charged, or paid on a per-year basis, commonly used for subscriptions, insurance, and salary figures.

examples.japanese: {年額|ねんがく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: To pay on a yearly basis.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{年額|ねんがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一万円|いちまんえん}です。
examples.english: The annual fee for this service is 10,000 yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{月額|げつがく}→月額：09739_getsugaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{年額|ねんがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Switching the insurance premium from monthly to annual makes it a little cheaper.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (year) and ⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ (amount). Used to express the total amount of money charged, earned, or paid over the span of one year. Common in financial, insurance, subscription, and tax contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年額|ねんがく}⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧: annual plan
- {年額|ねんがく}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: annual fee/rate
- {年額|ねんがく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}する→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧: to calculate on an annual basis
- {年額|ねんがく}⟦{換算|かんさん}→換算：07992_kansan⟧: annualized equivalent

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{月額|げつがく}→月額：09739_getsugaku⟧: monthly amount — the monthly counterpart
- {日額|にちがく}: daily amount — the daily counterpart
- ⟦{総額|そうがく}→総額：05472_sougaku⟧: total amount — the grand total regardless of time period
- ⟦{年収|ねんしゅう}→年収：05504_nenshuu⟧: annual income — specifically refers to income/earnings
